desc: The Inglis L9A1 is meant to give the collector or WWII enthusiast a historically accurate reproduction Hi-Power at a price point that any budget can afford. Built using forged components and high-quality 4140 button-rifled barrels for a durable, but accurate pistol, the L9A1 Looks and feels the part of its ancestor. The slick black chromate finish and checked polymer grips are complimented with Browning dovetail military type sights, a ring hammer, extended ambidextrous safety and period correct lanyard loop.
